mark_watched.name: Mark as watched
mark_watched.description: Marks a single video as watched, so the counter goes down.

video_id.name: Video ID
video_id.description: The YouTube video ID, for example vISlC2f0Bu8.

url.name: URL
url.description: Full YouTube URL. An alternative to the video ID.

mark_unwatched.name: Mark as unwatched
mark_unwatched.description: Puts a single video back to unwatched.

video_id.name: Video ID
video_id.description: The YouTube video ID, for example vISlC2f0Bu8.

url.name: URL
url.description: Full YouTube URL. An alternative to the video ID.

mark_all_watched.name: Mark everything as watched
mark_all_watched.description: Clears all unwatched videos. Without a selection this applies to every channel.

entity_id.name: Channels
entity_id.description: The sensors you want to clear. Leave empty for all channels.
